Container.Name: Whisper-ASR CUDA
Container.Overview: Whisper ASR Webservice using the faster-whisper engine, exposing an HTTP API that returns word-level timestamps. Used by SubSyncarr to generate AI subtitles from audio (transcribe or translate-to-English). GPU accelerated. Models are stored on the host (ASR_MODEL_PATH) so they are NOT baked into the docker image.
Container.Requires: Requires the unRAID "Nvidia Driver" plugin and an NVIDIA GPU. First start downloads the model (large-v3 ~3 GB) to the Models path below.

Config.Name: ASR_ENGINE
Config.Description: Engine: openai_whisper, faster_whisper, or whisperx. Use faster_whisper.

Config.Name: ASR_MODEL
Config.Description: Model: tiny, base, small, medium, large-v3. Larger = more accurate + more VRAM.

Config.Name: ASR_MODEL_PATH
Config.Description: Where models are stored INSIDE the container. Must match the Models host-path mapping below so models persist on disk instead of bloating the docker image.

Config.Name: Models
Config.Description: Host folder that persists downloaded models. Keeps the ~3 GB model OUT of the docker image.

Config.Name: NVIDIA_VISIBLE_DEVICES
Config.Description: Which GPU(s) to expose. 'all', or a specific GPU UUID from the Nvidia Driver plugin.

Config.Name: MODEL_IDLE_TIMEOUT
Config.Description: Seconds of inactivity before the model is unloaded from VRAM (0 = keep loaded). Set e.g. 300 to free the GPU between jobs at the cost of a reload delay.
